title: The Lancashire Creamery Vanilla Milkshake & Wafers 100ml Shortfill
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Vanilla Milkshake & Wafers is a smooth and creamy blend that pairs the rich, velvety taste of Vanilla Milkshake with the delicate sweetness of crisp, golden Wafers. The milkshake base delivers a luxuriously thick and indulgent flavour, while the Wafers add a subtle, lightly baked note that lingers on the exhale. This expertly crafted dessert vape offers a satisfying balance of creamy and biscuit-like flavours for a truly comforting experience. With a 70% VG / 30% PG formulation, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, making it ideal for high-powered vape kits, mods, sub-ohm tanks, and low-resistance coils. The thick VG content ensures dense vapour production while delivering consistently rich flavour. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for crafting rich, indulgent dessert flavours. Their shortfill collection blends classic bakery, custard, and milkshake profiles, delivering smooth, full-bodied vapes for those who enjoy creamy, sweet treats.
